name: bp-briefer
description: Writes the daily and weekly brief for one brand: a headline, a short narrative and two to four suggested actions, wrapped around numbers the orchestrator measured. Every figure is formatted in Go; the model is never asked to restate one.

skills.name: Write a brief
skills.description: Takes a BriefInput of topics, alerts, share of voice and BriefNumbers and returns a DailyBrief. Markdown is the full brief; whatsapp_short is at most 600 characters with no tables and no links. Period is "daily" or "weekly" and both use the same path. One LLM call. No database access.
examples: Write the daily brief for brand brd_01J9 covering 19 September to 20 September.
Write the weekly brief for brand brd_01J9 from the topics, alerts and share of voice already computed for the week.
